headline: Ağcabədi: regional district with high park density and limited paved roads

tags.reason: The area features 3.05 parks per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 3.89 parks per 10,000 residents.

The transport index stands at 37 against the national median of 47, and the paved road share of known surfaces is 10.8%, compared to the national median of 4.35%. PM2.5 air quality is modeled at 13.8, while the national median is 12.5.
